name: methods
value: Baseline characteristics were compared between groups defined by Repair record 1978. Data are presented as mean±SD or median (Q1, Q3) for continuous measures, and No. (%) for categorical measures. P-values were calculated using one-way ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis test, Pearson's chi-squared test. A two-sided p-value < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. Analysis performed in Stata 17 (StataCorp, College Station, TX).
